purpose: Verify complete approved purge basis path: retention expired -> purge request created -> IT Head approves -> permanently purged.
preconditions: Archived historical record exists with retention_expiry_date in the past.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits purge request; IT Head reviews and approves with comments.
expected_result: Purge request status transitions from pending_it_head to approved/completed; target record permanently purged.

purpose: Verify complete rejected purge basis path: retention expired -> purge request created -> IT Head rejects -> data remains archived.
preconditions: Archived historical record exists with retention_expiry_date in the past.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits purge request; IT Head reviews and rejects with justification comments.
expected_result: Purge request status transitions to rejected; target record remains preserved in archive database.

purpose: Verify composite purge lifecycle decision branch 2A (Approve path traversal).
preconditions: Archived user or data retention period has elapsed.
action_or_input: Super Admin creates purge request, IT Head submits decision='approve'.
expected_result: Purge request executed and target data purged.

purpose: Verify composite purge lifecycle decision branch 2B (Reject path traversal).
preconditions: Archived record retention period elapsed.
action_or_input: Super Admin creates purge request, IT Head submits decision='reject'.
expected_result: Purge request rejected; archived record remains active in archive.

purpose: Verify immediate time-bound role assignment to automatic expiry path traversal.
preconditions: Basic user is active; role is valid and available.
action_or_input: Super Admin assigns time-bound role effective immediately (start_date=today); system later executes role expiry on end_date.
expected_result: Initial state is active; upon reaching end_date, assignment status transitions automatically to expired.

purpose: Verify future-dated role assignment lifecycle: scheduled -> automatic activation -> automatic expiry.
preconditions: Basic user is active; role assignment parameters have future start date.
action_or_input: Super Admin assigns role with future start date; system triggers activation on start_date, then expiry on end_date.
expected_result: Status transitions from scheduled to active, and finally to expired.

purpose: Verify role validity extension workflow traversal: active -> extended validity -> expiry at new end date.
preconditions: Role assignment is in active status nearing scheduled end date.
action_or_input: Super Admin submits extension with approval reference and new future end date; system expires role at new end date.
expected_result: Assignment status transitions to extended with updated end_date, and expires when new end date passes.

purpose: Verify composite role lifecycle branch A: immediate assignment progression to expiry.
preconditions: User active, role available.
action_or_input: Assign role with start_date=today, end_date=today+10; run expire_time_bound_roles after end_date.
expected_result: Assignment enters active status, then transitions to expired.

purpose: Verify composite role lifecycle branch B: future-dated assignment activation and expiry progression.
preconditions: User active, role available.
action_or_input: Assign role with start_date in future; run activate_scheduled_roles, then run expire_time_bound_roles after end_date.
expected_result: Assignment transitions from scheduled to active to expired.

purpose: Verify composite role lifecycle branch C: extension traversal prior to expiry.
preconditions: Active role assignment nearing expiry.
action_or_input: Super Admin extends role validity with approval reference; system verifies new end date.
expected_result: Assignment status set to extended; expiry deferred until new end date.

purpose: Verify composite role lifecycle branch D: early standard revocation with notice.
preconditions: Active role assignment.
action_or_input: Super Admin schedules standard revocation with effective_date=today+2 days and task disposition.
expected_result: Role assignment status set to revoked, revocation timestamp and reason recorded.

purpose: Verify composite role lifecycle branch E: emergency revocation immediate traversal.
preconditions: Active role assignment.
action_or_input: Super Admin executes revocation with is_emergency=True.
expected_result: Role revoked immediately; permissions terminated.

purpose: Verify composite role lifecycle branch F: reassignment with task handover.
preconditions: Active role assignment held by User 1; User 2 active and eligible.
action_or_input: Super Admin reassigns role to User 2 with pending_task_disposition='transfer'.
expected_result: User 1 assignment marked reassigned with audit window; User 2 receives active assignment.

purpose: Verify deactivated user reactivation basis path: active -> deactivated -> reactivated -> active.
preconditions: User is active with baseline access.
action_or_input: Super Admin deactivates user account; subsequently Super Admin reactivates account.
expected_result: User status transitions from active to deactivated, then back to active with dashboard access restored.

purpose: Verify archived user restoration within reversible window: deactivated -> archived reversible -> restored active.
preconditions: User is deactivated and past minimum deactivation interval.
action_or_input: Super Admin archives user; later submits restoration within window with authorization reference.
expected_result: Archival record created in reversible status; restoration successfully restores user to active status.

purpose: Verify archived user reversibility window expiry path: deactivated -> archived reversible -> window expires -> permanent non-restorable.
preconditions: User is deactivated and archived.
action_or_input: Archival reversible window passes; system triggers finalize_non_restorable_archived_users.
expected_result: ArchivedUser record transitions from reversible to permanent_non_restorable status.

purpose: Verify composite lifecycle branch 1A: deactivated user direct reactivation path.
preconditions: User in deactivated status.
action_or_input: Super Admin invokes reactivate_user.
expected_result: User status becomes active.

purpose: Verify composite lifecycle branch 1B -> 2A: deactivated user archival followed by valid restoration.
preconditions: User in deactivated status.
action_or_input: Super Admin archives user, then restores user with authorization reference.
expected_result: User restored to active status.

purpose: Verify composite lifecycle branch 1B -> 2B: deactivated user archival followed by reversibility window expiry.
preconditions: User in deactivated status.
action_or_input: User archived; reversibility deadline passes; system finalizes non-restorable accounts.
expected_result: Record status becomes permanent_non_restorable.

purpose: Verify composite lifecycle guard condition: premature archival rejected when deactivation interval unelapsed.
preconditions: User deactivated recently (unelapsed minimum interval).
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts archival without bypass flag.
expected_result: Transition rejected; user remains in deactivated state.

purpose: Verify composite lifecycle guard condition: restoration rejected after reversible period expires.
preconditions: Archived user record with expired reversibility deadline.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts restoration.
expected_result: Restoration rejected; account remains non-restorable.

purpose: Verify historical data archive and restore basis path: operational data -> archived with backup -> restored with approval.
preconditions: Historical operational data meets retention/completion criteria.
action_or_input: Super Admin archives historical data with mandatory backup; later restores historical data with approval reference.
expected_result: Data archived successfully with backup reference; subsequent restoration transitions status to restored.

purpose: Verify historical archival guard condition: invalid date range rejects archival transition.
preconditions: Date range end is earlier than date range start.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts historical data archival with inverted dates.
expected_result: Transition rejected; no archived record created.

purpose: Verify historical restoration guard condition: missing approval reference rejects restoration transition.
preconditions: Historical data is in archived status.
action_or_input: Super Admin attempts restoration with empty approval reference.
expected_result: Transition rejected; historical record remains in archived status.
